headline: 2 killed, 1 injured in tank-firing accident; PM Tarique Rahman visits injured officer
summary: The Prime Minister visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) to check on an army officer critically injured during a field exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) this afternoon to check on an army officer critically injured in a tank-firing accident.
The accident occurred on Wednesday during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, while a tank was firing shells.
Two army personnel were killed in the incident, while the officer sustained serious injuries and was admitted to CMH for treatment.
During the visit, the Prime Minister enquired about the patient's condition and spoke with the officer and his family members.
Tarique Rahman wished the injured officer a speedy recovery and instructed hospital authorities to ensure he receives the best possible treatment.
The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their families.
caption:
A tank-firing accident during a field exercise in Hathazari has left two army personnel dead and one officer critically injured.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) this afternoon to check on an army officer critically injured in a tank-firing accident.

The accident occurred on Wednesday during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, while a tank was firing shells.

Two army personnel were killed in the incident, while the officer sustained serious injuries and was admitted to CMH for treatment.

During the visit, the Prime Minister enquired about the patient's condition and spoke with the officer and his family members.

Tarique Rahman wished the injured officer a speedy recovery and instructed hospital authorities to ensure he receives the best possible treatment.

The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their families.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV

headline: 2 held as crude bombs explode during AL procession in Gulshan
summary: Police arrested two people and recovered five crude bombs after activists of the banned Awami League held a flash procession in Dhaka's Gulshan.
details: Two crude bombs were detonated during a procession by activists of the banned Awami League in Dhaka's Gulshan this afternoon.
Gulshan Police Station Officer-in-Charge Daud Hossain stated that around 150-200 people attempted to bring out the procession on Road 3 of Gulshan 1 at around 11:45am.
When police tried to disperse the crowd, activists blasted two crude bombs, prompting police to fire two rounds of rubber bullets to disperse the gathering.
Videos circulating on social media showed participants chanting "Joy Bangla" during the event.
Police arrested two individuals from the spot and recovered five additional crude bombs left behind by the activists.
The Awami League's Dhaka City North unit confirmed via a Facebook post that they organized the procession.
